name: Model Test Harness
tagline: BYO RunPod key — load any HF model, tweak inputs, test outputs
why: A quick bench for testing model output quality without spinning up infrastructure each time — built for fellow coders who just want to poke at a model.
what: Paste your own RunPod API key, point it at any Hugging Face model link, edit the system prompt, and chat with the model to evaluate output quality. Runs on your key, so it costs you nothing to host and nothing for me to run.
disclaimer: For developers. This uses your own RunPod API key — nothing is charged to me, and your key stays in your browser session. Model availability depends on RunPod's GPUs, which can be inconsistent.
